statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-3832 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-12): when GnuTLS before 3.8.13 validates a certificate against an OCSP response with several entries, it checks the revocation status of the first entry instead of the one matching the certificate, so a revoked certificate can be accepted. GnuTLS fixes it in 3.8.13 (https://www.gnutls.org/security-new.html), and Alpine lists it as fixed in gnutls 3.8.13-r0 for 3.23 (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-3832). This owner is built from Alpine's gnutls package source for 3.23. Its published gnutls packages for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, x86_64 and aarch64, are 3.8.11-r0 and 3.8.12-r0, whose libgnutls library reports GnuTLS 3.8.11 and 3.8.12, and the current 3.8.13-r0, whose library reports GnuTLS 3.8.13. The range ends at 3.8.13-r0.

This owner is built from Alpine's gnutls package source for 3.23. Its published gnutls packages for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, x86_64 and aarch64, are 3.8.11-r0 and 3.8.12-r0, whose libgnutls library reports GnuTLS 3.8.11 and 3.8.12, and the current 3.8.13-r0, whose library reports GnuTLS 3.8.13. The range ends at 3.8.13-r0.
